## Important Rules

1. **Test as a user.** Never read source code during browser discovery. Use realistic end-to-end flows and check the console after every interaction.
2. **Credentials stay redacted.** Write `[REDACTED]` for any password or token in repro steps.
3. **Always open the browser.** /qa is browser-based QA, and the user invoked it to see the running app. Open the browser on every run, whatever the diff contains: prompt templates, config files, migrations, background jobs, or backend code all change what the app does. When the diff maps to no page, run Quick mode (homepage plus the top 5 navigation targets) and report what you saw.
4. **Tests and evals are not substitutes.** You may mention that unit tests or evals would add coverage, but only after the browser pass, never instead of it. Do not ask the user whether browser testing is needed.
5. **Never delete output files.** Screenshots and reports accumulate.
